headline: Exchanges Shed 767.7 Million Dollars In 24 Hours
narrative: Clean assets across exchanges fell 767.7 million dollars over 24 hours. The figure is the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the drop means that money left the exchanges. OKX shed 343.4 million dollars and Bitstamp shed 428.7 million, while Bitfinex took in 150.6 million.
author: jordan
